name: Alpha Peccary
harvest: Bio Scrap, Peccary Alpha Skull, Raw Peccary Chop, Milk Sac, Raw Alien Drumstick
summary: Alpha Peccary is a hostile creature found in the facility. It has a rare chance of spawning in place of a Sow Peccary in a handful of locations.

name: Archivist
drops: Purported Grimoire, Tactical Scrap, Lodestone Fragment, Ornate Key
harvest: Human Skull
summary: Archivists, otherwise known as Clericium, are Order-affiliated NPCs that spawn in the Praetorium.

name: Armored Exor
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Exor Heart, Vibrant Exor Arm, Exor Quill, Raw Alien Drumstick
summary: The Armored Exor is an enemy entity found in the Hydroplant. It is the second evolved variant of the Exor.

name: Assassin
drops: Kevlar Scrap, Magnetic Alloy, Carbon Plating, Tactical Scrap, Ornate Knife, Ornate Key
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Interfector Sleeves, Interfector Chestwraps, Interfector Breeches, Interfector Helm
summary: An Assassin is an elite soldier of The Order found in the Praetorium, Residence Sector, and Fragments.

name: Behemoth
harvest: Tarasque Ichor, Behemoth Skull
summary: === Behavior === The Behemoth can be found within the Dusk Reactor's chamber, lurking in a nearby corner. It becomes hostile upon noticing the player or any enemies. It has all the same attacks and behaviors as the Tarasque.

name: Big Hive Larva
harvest: Raw Larva Meat, Big Larva Figurine
summary: Big Hive Larva is a hostile creature found in the Hive area of The Encroachment.

name: Big Larva
harvest: Raw Larva Meat, Big Larva Figurine
summary: Big Larva is a hostile creature found in The Encroachment.

name: Bigfoot
harvest: Yeti Fur, Tech Scrap, Carbon Plating, Frozen Essence
summary: The Bigfoot is a hostile entity that roams the dormitory in Residence Sector.

name: Bigogi
drops: Black Gunk, Corrupted Lamogi Data
summary: === Behavior === Bigogi is a slow and tanky boss enemy. Bigogi will repeatedly charge and run into the direction of the player, attempting to push and damage them.

name: Bogman
harvest: Bio Scrap, Dead Plant, Leather Scrap, Lodestone Fragment
summary: The Bogman, registry ID IS-0422, is a hostile entity found in the Marshlands in Canaan.

name: Bombogi
summary: === Behavior === Bombogi are quick and, when aggro'd, begin a timer to detonate. Bombogi are set off by a jump on their head and subsequent jumps cause the Bombogi to be knocked back.

name: Breacher
drops: Cracked Shoulder Light, Military Electronics, 12g Buckshot, Romag Shotgun, Money, Breacher Helmet, Ornate Key, Military M.R.E., Light Gun Repair Kit, Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: Penitents deployed on the frontlines by The Order to atone for their sins, Breachers are enemies found in various locations throughout the Cascade Laboratories. Wearing highly durable armor, and armed with pump-action shotguns they're a dangerous (albeit relatively rare) sight to see among Order soldiers and are predominantly encountered in the Labs Sector guarding high-value areas alongside other order soldiers, however they can also be encountered alone on solo patrols.

name: Captain
drops: Captain's Beret, Military Electronics, .357 Magnum Ammo, Cracked Shoulder Light, Radio Pack, Talagi Magnum, Money, Ornate Key, Military M.R.E., Frag Grenade
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: The Order's finest field officers, Captains are hostile enemies first found in Manufacturing West. Adorned with their signature Red Berets and armed with a Magnum Revolver, they're often seen alongside Grunts and other Order soldiers in areas of critical importance like blockades or command centers.

name: Carbuncle
harvest: Raw Carbuncle
summary: The Carbuncle is a hostile creature found in the Facilities.

name: Chieftain
drops: Arcane Scrap, .357 Magnum Ammo, Chieftain Pack, GATE Defense Rune, Lodestone Fragment, Manomin Magnum
harvest: Bio Scrap, Chieftain Skull, Human Arm (Military), Kevlar Scrap
summary: The Gatekeepers' unit leaders, Chieftains are enemies found in Reactors, Shadowgate, and Residence Sector.

name: Close-Quarters Combatant
drops: Romag Shotgun, 12g Buckshot, Magnetic Alloy, Military Electronics, Cracked Shoulder Light, CQC Helmet, Military M.R.E., Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Mountaineer Armguards, Mountaineer Chestplate, Mountaineer Leggings
summary: Close-Quarters Combatants are found in Voussoir, and are often seen patrolling or in stationary locations. They are also commonly found in a squad with other Order soldiers.

name: Composer
drops: Organ, Porcelain Shards, Porcelain Key, Porcelain Tablet
summary: Composer is a hostile creature found in Flathill, Hydroplant, and Reactors.

name: Containment Bot
drops: Jailbroken CPU, Vit, Fizz Bang, Rootbear, Pop Snarkle, Kizz Cola
harvest: Metal Scrap, Glass Scrap, Tech Scrap, Coil, Robot Oil
summary: Containment Bot is a hostile robot found in Cascade Laboratories, it is a stronger variant of the Security Bot.

name: Corpsewalker
summary: Corpsewalker, like their crossover counterpart, is a large black humanoid figure which appears randomly around the player floating in a blank reference pose.

name: Corrupted Bot
drops: Heart of Corruption, Murkweed
harvest: Tech Scrap, Robot Oil, Arcane Scrap, GATE Defense Rune
summary: The Corrupted Bot, or G.E.A.R, is an enemy found within GATE Facilities, notably within Cascade's Mist Reactor and Residence Sector.

name: Coworker
drops: Human Skull
summary: Coworker is a passive entity that occasionally appears at night.

name: Darkwater Beast
summary: The Darkwater Beast is a hostile entity that swims within the Hydroplant's reservoir waters. The Darkwater Beast can also be found later in the water beneath the Gale Reactor.

name: Defense Bot
drops: Reinforced CPU, Frag Grenade, Rebar
harvest: Tech Scrap, Coil Winding, Transformer Bushing, Coil, Robot Oil, Toroidal Power Transformer, Human Skull
summary: The Defense Bot is a robotic enemy first encountered in the Hydroplant sector.

name: Electro-Pest
harvest: Capacitor, Tech Scrap, Raw Pest, Raw Pest Rump, Bio Scrap
summary: === Behavior === Like a standard Pest, the Electro-Pest leaps at its target, causing damage on contact. However, when it begins its leap, it emits a shock ring, dealing 30 Blunt Stun damage to anything in its radius. This can occur only once every 3.5 seconds. If the Electro-Pest's shock ring is charged, attacking it at close range will damage the attacker for 30 Blunt Stun damage.

name: Exor
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Exor Heart, Exor Arm, Exor Quill, Raw Alien Drumstick
summary: Exor is a hostile creature found in the Facilities, especially around the Adjustment Wing in Cascade Laboratories.

name: Exor Cha
drops: Exor Spear
harvest: Bio Scrap, Exor Skull, Raw Alien Drumstick, Milk Sac
summary: The Exor Cha is an enemy entity found in the Reactors as well as in Village Den da'ko Yeer. It is the third evolved variant of the Exor.

name: Exor Monk
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Exor Heart, Raw Alien Drumstick
summary: Energy Blast Attack: * Range: Long range * Dodge Strategy: Timed Dodge: Wait for the animation (raising arm, launching energy blast) before side stepping. Melee Attack: * Range: Short range (1-2 storage crates) * Dodge Strategy: Preemptive Dodge: Maintain a distance greater than 2 storage crates, or dodge backwards/opposite direction when the Monk crouches and raises it's arm. * Speed: Fast, cannot be reacted to. Teleport: * Teleportation: Teleports to safe distance after using energy blast attack or melee attack.

name: Farmer
drops: Silver Scrap, Pitchfork
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Pilgrim Hat
summary: Farmer is a hostile enemy found in Canaan.

name: Flame Rat
drops: Lodestone Fragment, Tactical Scrap, Black Oil
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), High Inquisitor Suit
summary: Flame Rat is a Order soldier found in the Praetorium.

name: Furfur
summary: Furfur, like their crossover counterpart, is a humanoid demonic creature with a deer skull as a head and a dark red body. It has long, thin arms that are similar to those of a mantis, with the end of the arms splitting into two thin pincers with what can only be described as a sharp thumb. It appears to have the legs of a human, however twisted seemingly below the knee.

name: Garage Rat
drops: Pipe Wrench, Oil, Tactical Scrap, Reinforced CPU, Ornate Key
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Rat Suit
summary: === Behavior === The Garage Rat is usually seen patrolling around vehicles or doing maintenance. Unlike their more common brethren, a Garage Rat won't flee from danger.

name: Giant Power Leech
drops: Powdered Crystal, Circuit Board, Capacitor, Electrical Organ
summary: The Giant Power Leech, AKA IS-0211, is a large, semi-crystalline creature originating from Anteverse 23 which appears during the Rolling Blackout Weather Event.

name: Grunt
drops: Order Helmet, 9mm Ammo, Military Electronics, Military Pack, Montese SMG, Money, Cracked Shoulder Light, Military M.R.E., Light Gun Repair Kit, Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: The standard rank and file of the Order, Grunts are hostile enemies found throughout Manufacturing West and Cascade Laboratories. Armed with the Montese SMG, they're formidable opponents and especially dangerous in groups. They're usually found in squads with other Order soldiers, but can occasionally be seen guarding areas alone or accompanying a Lab Rat in a patrol.

name: Guard
drops: Silver Scrap, Splintered Crossbow
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Pilgrim Hat
summary: Guard is a hostile enemy found in Canaan.

name: Guard Grunt
drops: 9mm Ammo, Military Electronics, Security Pistol, Money, Cracked Shoulder Light, Military M.R.E., Light Gun Repair Kit, Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: The standard rank and file of the Order, Guard Grunts are hostile enemies found throughout Manufacturing West and Cascade Laboratories. Armed with the Security Pistol, they're formidable opponents and especially dangerous in groups. They're usually found in squads with other Order soldiers, but can occasionally be seen guarding areas alone or accompanying a Lab Rat in a patrol.

name: Guardian of the Fallow
drops: Arcane Scrap, Imbued Parchment, Lodestone Fragment, GATE Defense Rune
harvest: Bio Scrap, Mystagogue's Head, Human Arm (Military)
summary: The Guardian of the Fallow can be found in Residence Sector as one of the Gatekeepers of the Fallow defending the Dark Lens.

name: Hive Larva
harvest: Raw Larva Meat, Larva Figurine
summary: Hive Larva is a hostile creature found in the Hive area of The Encroachment.

name: IS-0139
drops: Powdered Crystal
summary: IS-0139s, also known by a fan name Crystallisks, are hostile creatures found in the mines of Manufacturing West, in Cascade Laboratories and Hydroplant.

name: Jotun
drops: Arcane Scrap, .308 Ammo, GATE Defense Rune, Lodestone Fragment
harvest: Bio Scrap, Head of a Giant, Kevlar Scrap, Giant's Pack
summary: The Gatekeepers' bulwark against the terror, Jotun are enemies found in Reactors, Shadowgate, and Residence Sector.

name: Jotun of the Fallow
drops: Arcane Scrap, .308 Ammo, GATE Defense Rune, Lodestone Fragment
harvest: Bio Scrap, Head of a Giant, Kevlar Scrap, Giant's Pack
summary: The Jotun of the Fallow can be found in Residence Sector as one of the Gatekeepers of the Fallow defending the Dark Lens.

name: Krasue
drops: Frozen Essence
summary: Krasue is a hostile entity that appears after entering the Residence Sector. She is a low temperature variation of the Leyak that appears in cold places and will try to freeze its target in place.

name: Lab Rat
drops: Rat Scanner, Rat Pack, Tech Scrap, Metal Scrap, Glass Scrap, Plastic Scrap, Cloth Scrap, Ornate Key, Lodestone Fragment, Hexwood
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Rat Suit
summary: Lab Rat is a neutral Order soldier found in the Facilities. They begin to appear in the facility (most notably the Office Sector) as the player progress.

name: Lamogi
drops: Black Gunk
summary: === Behavior === Lamogi are quick and rely on heavy knockback. Lamogi die instantly from a single jump on their head.

name: Larva
harvest: Raw Larva Meat, Larva Figurine
summary: Larva are small grubs found in The Encroachment. Weak, slow, and only dangerous to the unaware and unarmored, they won't pose much of a threat to a prepared and aware scientist.

name: Leyak
drops: Leyak Essence
summary: Leyak is a hostile entity that appears after entering XR Containment in Cascade Laboratories.

name: Lodeite
drops: Silver Scrap, Lodestone Fragment
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull
summary: Lodeites are a hostile enemy found in Canaan.

name: Medic
drops: Medic Helmet, 9mm Ammo, Military Electronics, Military Pack, Montese SMG, Money, Cracked Shoulder Light, Military M.R.E., Light Gun Repair Kit
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Exsurgo Armwraps, Exsurgo Tactical Plate, Exsurgo Shinguards
summary: Medic is a hostile soldier first found in Manufacturing West. They have the unique ability to heal downed Order soldiers.

name: Mother of the Fallow
drops: Arcane Scrap, Embellished Censer, 12g Buckshot, Lodestone Fragment, GATE Defense Rune
harvest: Bio Scrap, Witch Skull
summary: The Mother of the Fallow can be found in Residence Sector as one of the Gatekeepers of the Fallow defending the Dark Lens.

name: Mountaineer
drops: Mountaineer Helmet, Patois Rifle, 5.56 Ammo, Kevlar Scrap, Military Electronics, Cracked Shoulder Light, Alpine Pack, Military M.R.E., Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Mountaineer Armguards, Mountaineer Chestplate, Mountaineer Leggings
summary: Mountaineers are found in Voussoir, and are often seen patrolling or in stationary locations. They are also commonly found in a squad with other Order soldiers.

name: Mushroom Carbuncle
harvest: Raw Carbuncle, Carbuncle Mushroom
summary: Shroom Carbuncle is a hostile creature found in the facility.

name: Mushroom Peccary
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Peccary Chop, Carbuncle Mushroom, Raw Alien Drumstick, Mushroom Peccary Skull
summary: Mushroom Peccary is a hostile creature found in the facility.

name: Mystagogue
drops: Arcane Scrap, Imbued Parchment, Lodestone Fragment, GATE Defense Rune
harvest: Bio Scrap, Mystagogue's Head, Human Arm (Military)
summary: The Gatekeepers' shamans, Mystagogues are enemies found in Reactors, Shadowgate, and Residence Sector.

name: Mystagogue Eye
drops: Flickering Eye, Arcane Scrap
summary: The Gatekeepers' Mystagogue support robots, Mystagogue Eyes are enemies found in Reactors and Shadowgate. After completing Reactors, they will appear in previous areas such as the Data Farm.

name: Neophyte
drops: Arcane Scrap, 5.56 Ammo, Smashed GATE NVGs, Lodestone Fragment, Gutnic Rifle
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Arm (Military), Kevlar Scrap, Human Skull
summary: The Gatekeepers' newest initiates and members who have yet to find their path, Neophytes are enemies found in Reactors, Shadowgate, and the Residence Sector.

name: Niketas
drops: Silver Scrap, The Diary of Niketas - 4
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Tech Scrap, Preacher's Hat
summary: Niketas is a unique hostile enemy that is the preacher and leader of the cult of Canaan.

name: Nyth
drops: Core Fragment, Raw Larva Meat, Hive Larva Figurine
summary: Nyth the Gluttonous is a hostile creature found in The Encroachment.

name: Patriarch of the Fallow
drops: Arcane Scrap, .357 Magnum Ammo, Chieftain Pack, GATE Defense Rune, Lodestone Fragment, Manomin Magnum
harvest: Bio Scrap, Chieftain Skull, Human Arm (Military), Kevlar Scrap
summary: The Patriarch of the Fallow can be found in Residence Sector as one of the Gatekeepers of the Fallow defending the Dark Lens.

name: Peccary
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Peccary Chop, Raw Alien Drumstick, Peccary Skull
summary: === Combat === When it is not in combat, the Peccary will patrol its area, possibly making use of its ability to plant a Carbuncle on a surface along its patrol route using its tail. During combat, the Peccary is an aggressive entity that will charge into its target. It will either tackle against the enemy or perform a leap attack to close the distance. It also has a more dangerous charged attack, where its body will spark with energy before sprinting in a straight line.

name: Peccary Sow
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Peccary Chop, Milk Sac, Leather Scrap, Raw Alien Drumstick, Sow Skull
summary: Peccary Sow is a hostile creature found in the facility. This specific variant readily spawns in the Wildlife Pens in Cascade Laboratories.

name: Pest
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Pest Rump, Raw Pest
summary: The Pest, registry ID IS-0173-A, is a hostile creature found in the Facilities that is originally from Anteverse 2. It is a rather small creature, taking the shape of a spiked potato or bread loaf, and is the most common creature encountered. It prefers to hide in various nooks and corners to ambush its prey, be it under desks, in vents, or behind boxes.

name: Power Leech
drops: Powdered Crystal, Circuit Board, Capacitor, Electrical Organ
summary: The Power Leech, AKA IS-0211, is a parasite-like creature originating from Anteverse 17 which appears during the Rolling Blackout Weather Event.

name: Reaper
drops: Night Essence
summary: The Reaper is a hostile entity that roams the Security Sector.

name: Rook
drops: Rook Helmet, Riot Shield, Sensor, Military Electronics, Cracked Shoulder Light, Combat Knife, Military M.R.E., Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Mountaineer Armguards, Mountaineer Chestplate, Mountaineer Leggings
summary: The Rook is an Order soldier first encountered in Voussoir.

name: Sapper
drops: PETN, Rat Pack, Lodestone Fragment, Ornate Key
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military), Sapper Suit
summary: Sappers are hostile enemies introduced in the Reactors.

name: Security Bot
drops: Security Bot CPU, Vit, Fizz Bang, Rootbear, Pop Snarkle, Slam
harvest: Metal Scrap, Glass Scrap, Tech Scrap, Coil, Robot Oil
summary: The Security Bot is a hostile enemy found within GATE Facilities, notably within Cascade's Office Sector and Manufacturing West.

name: Shield Trooper
drops: Riot Shield, Sensor, Military Electronics, Cracked Shoulder Light, Combat Knife, Military M.R.E., Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: Shield Trooper is an Order soldier encountered in the Praetorium. She is the female counterpart to the winterized Rook, with slightly more health.

name: Shock Trooper
drops: Romag Shotgun, 12g Buckshot, Magnetic Alloy, Military Electronics, Cracked Shoulder Light, CQC Helmet, Military M.R.E., Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: Shock Troopers are found in the Praetorium, and are often seen patrolling or in stationary locations. They are identical to Close-Quarters Combatants except in appearance.

name: Skink
harvest: Skink Skull, Raw Skink Meat, Green Fish Liver, Fish Bones, Radfish
summary: Skinks are hostile creatures found around the Cloud Reactor. They can be tamed, turning them into Skink (Item).

name: Sniper
drops: Cracked Shoulder Light, .308 Ammo, Military Electronics, Wessex Rifle, Journal, Money, Canteen, Military M.R.E., Light Gun Repair Kit, Cloth Scrap
harvest: Human Arm (Military), Sniper Skull, Sagittarii Stealth Plate, Sagittarii Leggings, Sagittarii Stabilizers
summary: Long-ranged, cold blooded killers of The Order, Snipers are hostile enemies found in key spots in Manufacturing West, Cascade Laboratories and the Hydroplant. Armed with High-Caliber Sniper Rifles, they often guard critical locations from intruders by executing them from afar, long before they realize what's going on.

name: Snow Peccary
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Alien Drumstick, Raw Peccary Chop, Yeti Fur, Snow Peccary Skull
summary: === Behavior === Snow Peccaries will passively wander around, becoming hostile towards all entities, Gatekeepers, the player and Deployable Objects placed by the player. They cannot open doors, unless in a hostile state. Occasionally, they will spawn Tainted Carbuncles on the floor.

name: Snow Pest
harvest: Bio Scrap, Raw Pest, Raw Pest Rump, Yeti Fur
summary: The Snow Pest is a hostile creature found in the Residence Sector that is originally from Anteverse 2. It is an winterized adaptation of the common Pest, having a coat of thick fur to protect against frigid environments. It prefers to hide in various nooks and corners to ambush it's prey, be it under desks, in vents, or behind boxes.

name: Symphonist
drops: Symphonist Head, Porcelain Shards, Porcelain Key, Organ, Porcelain Tablet
summary: The Symphonist is a hostile creature found in Flathill and in the Facility during Fog Phenomenon Weather Events. They can only spawn after fully completing Flathill.

name: Tainted Carbuncle
harvest: Raw Carbuncle
summary: Tainted Carbuncle is a hostile creature found in the Facilities. It is a variant of the Carbuncle.

name: Tarasque
harvest: Tarasque Ichor, Tarasque Skull
summary: Tarasque is a hostile creature found in the Containment area in Cascade Laboratories. It is located in Containment Block Anning.

name: The Moving Box
summary: The Moving Box, registry ID IS-0247, is a small non-hostile walking box that occasionally follows the player around after progressing through Flathill. It appears as a rough organic cube with a pair of quasi-humanoid legs.

name: The Snowman (Enemy)
drops: Carrot, Snowman's Top Hat, Snowman's Scarf, Snowball, Hexwood
summary: The Snowman is a hostile creature found in North Pole, standing in front of the burning Christmas tree in the center. They are inactive until a player 'adjusts their top hat'.

name: The Wayseeker (Enemy)
summary: The Wayseeker, also known as IS-0117, is an eldritch entity of monstrous size. It is first seen when it is entrapped in Shadowgate by Gatekeepers. And can be fought when Albatross has been reached. It is a long, difficult fight that will drain most of the players resources if they're not well-prepared.

name: Torchbearer
drops: Silver Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Pilgrim Hat
summary: Torchbearers are a hostile enemy found in Canaan.

name: Trooper
drops: Patois Rifle, 5.56 Ammo, Kevlar Scrap, Military Electronics, Cracked Shoulder Light, Military M.R.E., Cloth Scrap
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull, Human Arm (Military)
summary: Troopers are found in the Praetorium, and are often seen patrolling or in stationary locations. They are identical to Mountaineers except in appearance.

name: Volatile Exor
harvest: Bio Scrap, Plutonic Blood, Exor Quill, Plutonic Carapace, Volatile Exor Skull
summary: Volatile Exor is a hostile creature found in the Dusk and Mist Reactors. It is the fourth evolved variant of the Exor.

name: Volatile Pest
harvest: Bio Scrap, Plutonic Carapace, Raw Pest Rump, Raw Pest
summary: Volatile Pest, registry ID IS-0173-C, is a further mutation of the Pest (IS-0173-A). It is most commonly found in the Reactors Sector. Volatile Pest emits a small amount of ambient radation and can explode on impact.

name: Witch
drops: Arcane Scrap, Embellished Censer, 12g Buckshot, Lodestone Fragment, GATE Defense Rune
harvest: Bio Scrap, Witch Skull
summary: The Gatekeepers' warrior witches, Witches are enemies found in Shadowgate and Residence Sector.

name: Woodsman
drops: Silver Scrap, Woodsman's Axe
harvest: Bio Scrap, Human Skull
summary: Woodsman is a hostile enemy found in Canaan.

name: Yeti
harvest: Yeti Skull, Yeti Fur
summary: The Yeti is a hostile entity that roams the area surrounding Voussoir.

name: Zombie
harvest: Human Skull, Bio Scrap
summary: Zombie is a hostile creature found in the Containment Block Helmholtz and in the Furniture Store.
